mapper.select: SELECT s.stage_id AS stageId, COUNT(*) AS stepCount FROM step s LEFT JOIN step_permission sp ON sp.step_id = s.step_id AND sp.user_id = #{userId} WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.stage_id IS NOT NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND (sp.permission IS NULL OR sp.permission <> 'NONE') GROUP BY s.stage_id
